title: Career roadmap · Market Analyst
summary: A practical route from Applied Economics / Financial Economics into market research, financial analysis, investment research, business intelligence, economic analysis and data-driven market roles.

facts.Timeline assumption: This roadmap assumes a 4-year BA Honours pathway where applicable. A 3-year BA route can follow the same sequence by moving the final-year milestones one year earlier.

about.label: Route check
about.text: Market Analyst is directly aligned with the Applied Economics / Financial Economics course.

horizons.question: What can I enter now?
horizons.output: Build economics, statistics, financial-market, Excel and research skills and complete market-analysis projects.

horizons.question: How should I specialise?
horizons.output: Choose equity research, macroeconomics, financial markets, business research, risk or investment analysis.

horizons.question: How should I evolve?
horizons.output: Progress into senior market research, investment research, economic analysis, portfolio-support or strategy roles.

horizons.question: How can I remain relevant?
horizons.output: Combine economics with data, AI-assisted research, quantitative methods, alternative data and strategic decision-making.

Scholarships / fellowships
Potential routes include UGC scholarships, university funding, government schemes and research fellowships. Current eligibility and award amounts should be verified against the relevant notification.
Sponsorship note
Finance and market-research employers generally recruit directly. Government/regulatory roles follow their own recruitment processes rather than conventional sponsorship.

blocks.label: Application pack
blocks.text: Transcripts, degree/provisional certificate, CV, statement of purpose, academic references, quantitative coursework evidence, research/project portfolio, passport, English test where required and scholarship documents.

blocks.label: Visa/job-offer note
blocks.text: Post-study work rights and employment eligibility depend on the destination country. A market-analysis qualification does not automatically provide eligibility for regulated financial roles.

PhD routes
After a relevant master's degree, potential research areas include:
A PhD is useful for economic research, universities, central-bank/regulatory research, think tanks and advanced quantitative roles.
2040–2046 relevance

Market analysis will increasingly combine traditional economics with alternative data, machine learning, automated research, econometrics, real-time dashboards and AI-assisted financial analysis. The strongest analysts will remain valuable by understanding economic causality and market structure rather than relying only on automated predictions.
